title: Lazy Day Brandy Pie
description: A comforting dessert featuring lazy-made crust, rich brandy filling, and a crunchy nut topping.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add the brandy to the egg mixture and whisk until combined.
Pour the egg mixture into the pie crust.
Sprinkle the chopped nuts evenly over the top of the pie.
Bake the pie for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Chill the pie in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
